info.description:
This course creates opportunities for students to strengthen and integrate knowledge during the learning time at school.

Provide students enviroments to apply knowledge in reality. Develop the ability of creative thinking, question and problems solving during the internship period. In addition, students could participate to analyzse, research and solve specific problems related with major.
